purpose: Canonical registry of agent operational modes — execution posture, specialist persona, and composite mission presets. Replaces the hard-coded 4-mode enum with an extensible, verifiable catalogue.

standard.intent: Balanced execution with verification gates between phases.
standard.use_when: Default for ambiguous or mixed-scope missions.

aggressive.intent: Maximum throughput; parallelize independent lanes, minimize wait.
aggressive.use_when: Well-specified mechanical work with reversible mutations.

conservative.intent: Extra verification, rollback-safe, minimal blast radius.

dry_run.intent: Simulate; emit planned actions, perform zero mutations.
dry_run.use_when: Pre-flight review, proposal generation, risk assessment.

autonomous.intent: Self-directed with checkpointing and auto-heal on deviation.
autonomous.use_when: Long-horizon tasks with clear stop conditions.

swarm.intent: DAG fan-out across specialist workers with synthesis + verifier.

recovery.intent: Return to last verified state; rebuild forward from failure.
recovery.use_when: After first-path failure or invalidated assumption.

deep-swarm.intent: Long-horizon sequential reasoning distributed across a Diamond Agent Topography with Spiral Engine refinement.
deep-swarm.use_when: Missions demanding the absolute highest quality reasoning coupled with parallel lifecycle execution.

omni-swarm-lifetime.intent: Dynamic DAG task decomposition, non-blocking parallel worker dispatch across independent execution branches, and lifetime state tracking with zero-cost free-tier multi-model routing.
omni-swarm-lifetime.use_when: Full project lifetime autonomous development, parallel feature engineering, and cross-repo federation.

pro-elite.intent: Strongest version: omni-swarm parallelism fused with longest-horizon framework (Aspen-Grove durable memory, High Council multi-VP adjudication, sequential reasoning DAG, Bayesian confidence, make-it-heavy provenance, token-saver pointer compression). Zero-Hallucination Gate is the only blocking gate — refuses unverified claims, never blocks real work.
pro-elite.use_when: Maximum-coherent-advance missions where the operator wants the strongest composition available, every claim evidence-backed, every checkpoint recoverable, and zero progress lost to paralyzing gates.

deep-work-sequential-kernel.intent: Continuous 30-section sequential engineering lifecycle (Research -> Study -> Model -> Prioritize -> Design -> Build -> Test -> Integrate -> Measure -> Review -> Deploy -> Observe -> Improve -> Preserve -> Research Again).
deep-work-sequential-kernel.use_when: Continuous repository advancement where no material high-value work is left unresolved.

zero-hallucination-gate.note: The only gate that may refuse: refuses unverified claims, never blocks progress. Lives in longest-horizon as the highest-priority pre-commit check.

job-app-finalize.use_when: Finalizing a verifiable job-application completion surface (e.g. repo_excellence -> helix).

legal-strike.use_when: Producing a filing-ready legal artifact under deadline.

litigation-colossus.use_when: Building 1 complete, 7-pillar filing-ready case package per repository in its entirety from L0 evidence to proposed judicial orders.

deep-work-kernel.use_when: Executing the complete 30-section sequential engineering lifecycle until no material high-value work remains unresolved.

code-sprint.use_when: Closing real execution paths on a known codebase.

mesh-repair.use_when: Restoring a degraded connector or service mesh.

automatic-open-state.use_when: Default runtime state for immense quality lifecycle execution.

tower-of-babel.use_when: Massive multi-lingual orchestration, protocol bridging, and cross-domain unification missions.

mastermind-foundry.use_when: Full 4-wave autonomous foundry ignition across all estate repositories.

omni-swarm-lifetime.use_when: Full project lifetime dynamic orchestration of parallel specialist agents across all 17 canonical roles with zero-cost multi-model routing.

pro-elite.use_when: The strongest composition available: every claim evidence-backed via Zero-Hallucination Gate, every checkpoint recoverable via Aspen-Grove WORM, every contradiction adjudicated by High Council, every progress token-budgeted. Use when maximum-coherent-advance beats any cost optimization.

zero_hallucination_gate.principle: Gates stop hallucination, never block progress.
refuses: claims without tool evidence / source citation / test pass
never_refuses: operator-clarifying questions when intent is ambiguous
progress when verification is in-flight but not yet complete

verification.expect: all execution_modes + role_modes + composite_modes resolve with valid skill bindings
